disposition: No substantive correctness blocker for an accurately labeled synthetic v0.1 research preprint; native PDF compilation and visual layout remain the release owner responsibility.

gold_label_boundary.remarks: Selectors use public text/citations and the charged validator. Synthetic title/provenance coupling is declared. Natural pilot public inputs contain authored English contracts, while expression DAGs and impact labels are evaluator-only. Oracle unit-test responses validate the scorer, not model performance.

limits: Main experiment uses exact reference labels and isolated in-memory generated-block patches; not autonomous cross-file semantic editing.
No new exact statistical theorem, complete-system baseline reproduction or AI method superiority established.
Four edge-rate variants share each base; 1440 condition instances are not 1440 independent business tasks. All families use a common authored generator.
Validation-call counts exclude ranking, graph construction, reference computation and production infrastructure overhead; no token, money or latency inference.
Human notes are structurally protected by the numeric/generated-block patch API, not semantically reconciled.
Snapshot guard checks a supplied token against a stored token; live mutation detection, concurrency control and production deployment are not demonstrated.

The confidence statement concerns conceptual uniform audit randomization for a fixed population; fixed seeded runs are not a Monte Carlo coverage study and do not provide a 95% conditional gate-pass guarantee.
A tolerance of six stale claims is an authored demonstration setting, not validated business acceptability.
Natural-language pilot has six passing offline tests and frozen inputs; no successful model experiment. BYOK 502 feasibility failure is not a model-performance result.
Selected prior-work descriptions and upstream model-route status were read from research records, not independently re-fetched in this review.
Native compiler and final PDF visual verification are outside this reviewer pass.

resolved_review_findings.finding: The 95% bound is not conditional on gate pass and is not simultaneous corpus coverage.
resolved_review_findings.status: Explicit pass-conditional warning and fixed-realization caveat present in manuscript Results.

resolved_review_findings.finding: Report six unsafe releases, 34 bound failures, modest 7.69% call saving, fallback dominance and distinct denominators.
Figure x values are deletion probabilities rather than measured missing-edge percentages.
resolved_review_findings.status: Axis renamed to true-edge deletion probability by release owner.

review_type: Code, statistical implementation, raw-result, manuscript-scope and PNG-figure review; not peer review or production certification
